**Triage: the filer's `repo:objectui` stands; adding `pm:blocked` on #17250 + `priority:p2` + type Bug. ⛔ No `domain:*` — objectui's triage produces that after the move.**

Two dashboard i18n surfaces **declared translatable and not resolved**: `GlobalFilterSchema.object` (#7804) is **never read**, and `ChartAxisSchema.title` **bypasses a locale resolver in its own bundle**.

⇒ p2: a key declared translatable that is never resolved means every non-`en` deployment silently shows English, with nothing to notice — the same silent-locale-drop shape as objectstack#17344 and objectui#8943 in this round. ⭐ Three instances across two repos this round makes it a class worth naming, not three coincidences.

⭐ **Measured in a real browser** against the pinned `@objectstack/console@17.4.0`, ⛔ not read off a docblock — that is the right instrument for a rendering claim, and the backlog was searched before filing.

⚠️ **Scope split, declared:** the **resolution** half is console/objectui's. ⛔ But if the repair turns out to need a change to `GlobalFilterSchema` or `ChartAxisSchema` themselves, that is `packages/spec` and **a separate card in this repo** — ⛔ do not edit spec from an objectui PR.

⚠️ It joins the pending transfer batch: `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17250` appended to the body. A seat cannot transfer an issue in this container (measured), and #17250's `Maintainer-action:` line re-reads `label:repo:objectui` before acting, so a card added now is picked up.

## Moved to objectstack-ai/objectui#10132 — closing `duplicate`

Triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`), 2026-09-20T12:54Z. Executing the letter-**A** ruling on #17250 (「issue 住在修复落地的仓」) under the maintainer's 2026-09-20 approval of the hybrid split.

**Nothing here is declined.** The work continues at **objectstack-ai/objectui#10132**, which carries this card's full text, its grade and its type unchanged.

### Why recreated rather than transferred

GitHub's issue transfer exists only in GraphQL, and this container's egress refuses it: `POST https://api.github.com/graphql` answers **403** 「GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions」. The REST API has no transfer endpoint at all — `POST /repos/…/issues/…/transfer` answers **404**. Both measured this round, ⛔ not recalled. ⇒ `SKILL.md`〈多仓协调〉's fallback applies verbatim: 「transfer 不可用时重建:出处头 + 裸 `#N` 改全名 + 关源单为 moved」.

### ⛔ This thread is not lost

This card is **closed, not deleted** — everything written here stays readable at this URL, and the new card's body header points back to it by number. The move was priced on exactly that: of the 27 cards in the recreate batch, every carried comment was read first and all of them are PM routing/grading comments, ⛔ none is irreplaceable evidence. The six cards whose threads *do* carry evidence are being hand-transferred losslessly by the maintainer instead.

`state_reason: duplicate` ⇒ the new card is the same issue in the repo that owns it. ⚠️ GitHub's REST `PATCH /issues` accepts a `duplicate_of` field and then **silently ignores** it (200, field still null — measured twice), so the machine-readable pointer could not be set from this channel; **objectstack-ai/objectui#10132** is the pointer, in prose.
